questions.answer:
COMM 5007 Coding for Business
ECON 5206 Financial Econometrics

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your second semester. *
What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: ECON 5301 Markets and Frictions var et fedt fag. Niveauet var meget nær polit. Man skal dog være klar på, at det kræver lidt mere tid end de fleste andre fag, da der er en del hjemmeopgaver og quizer. Coding for Business og Financial Econometrics var også okay. De krævede ikke så meget, så gode fag at tage, hvis man gerne vil have lidt mere fritid.
